about: Every host the Clairix app or relay names in its source, and where it is accounted for. Checked in CI by .github/scripts/egress_check.py, which fails when the code names a host missing here, when a host here is no longer in the code, or when 'destinations' and the egress table on the security page (website/src/content/docs/security.md, #egress) list different rows. A destination's 'row' is the first cell of its table row, bold markers removed; 'hosts' are the host names the code names for it (none when the address comes from a signed file, from the user or from another relay at run time).

destinations.row: Clairix relay (our server, run on Cloudflare)
destinations.note: The relay's address comes from the signed relay list or from the user.

destinations.row: Your contact's relay, if they use another one
destinations.note: Federation: the other relay's address comes from the contact's number and the signed relay list.

links.account.samsung.com: Account checklist: opened in the browser when the user taps it.
links.clairix.app: The project's website: invite links the user shares (opened by the recipient), the terms and download pages opened when tapped, and the contact address in the tile requests' User-Agent.
links.f-droid.org: The foss edition's update notice: its F-Droid page, opened in the browser or F-Droid when tapped.
links.myaccount.google.com: Account checklist: opened in the browser when the user taps it.
links.play.google.com: The update notice's store link, opened when tapped.
links.relay.clairix.app: Example text in the relay address field; never fetched unless the user enters it.
links.smartthingsfind.samsung.com: Account checklist: opened in the browser when the user taps it.
links.support.google.com: Account checklist: opened in the browser when the user taps it.
links.wa.me: A hotline's WhatsApp chat, opened in WhatsApp when tapped.
links.www.google.com: Account checklist (Find My Device on the web): opened in the browser when tapped.
links.www.openstreetmap.org: The map's copyright link, opened when tapped, and the position link in an SOS text, opened by its recipient.

not_fetched.schemas.xmlsoap.org: XML namespace in the ONVIF discovery message the network sweep sends on the local Wi-Fi.
not_fetched.www.onvif.org: XML namespace in the ONVIF discovery message.
not_fetched.www.w3.org: XML namespace (SOAP envelope) in the ONVIF discovery message.
